context: Round 3. Settled in round 2 and not reopened: the weight line is the rate, the sessions line is what is due, days past the commitment append, the header gap, the slow-loss band, two cards. This round asks three things. (1) How short the rate line should be: the percent alone, the percent plus a word for where it sits, or the round-2 sentence. Every string is a PROPOSAL, wording is yours. Whatever the line drops sits in the tip, which these frames pin open. (2) The page: the phase tag has moved right, beside the status. (3) Alignment: both cards now put their track in one row template with fixed track and label heights, so the two cards end level and their tracks share a line. Measured on the page story: both cards 192 px tall at 1920 and 1440, both tracks centred on the same line; 155 px each at 360. The band numbers moved out of the track into that shared label row, and the sessions bar labels where the count due by now falls. The sessions tip line is now "3 leave this week" rather than "3 days leave the window this week".
